<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex13032023-09-0715-44-14" status="finalized" part="M" next="ex13032023-07-2512-47-06">
<lg><l>de ltar sangs rgyas bstan pa'i don chen sgran ||</l>
<l>chos 'jig <lb n="5a2"/> ces ltar snang ba mang po yis ||</l>
<l>zhing 'dir ring por mi thogs <choice><reg>zhub</reg><orig>'dub/zhub (?)</orig></choice> 'gyur bas ||</l>
<l>skyes bu spyad ldan rnaMs kyi <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3839">brtson 'grus</rs> <lb n="5a3"/> gyis ||</l>
<l><note type="gloss">ga</note> gzhung 'di chos kyi snying po la spyod kyang ||</l>
<l>'jig rten kun gyis cir mi shes pa'i ||</l>
<l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3839">dge slong seng ge</rs>s <lb n="5a4"/> snyigs ma'i mi rnams la ||</l>
<l>rang gi rnaM thar gtam du bsnyad pa yin ||</l>
<l>bstan pa'i gzhi dang rgyas dbye' bsgrub pa la |</l> 
<l><lb n="5a5"/> yang dag yang dag ma yin rnam dbye' dang ||</l>
<l><note type="gloss">cha</note> rang gyi kun spyod gtam pa rnaM lnga 'di ||</l>
<l>shag kya'i bstan la rnaM <lb n="5a6"/> dag byi dor yin ||</l></lg></seg></TEI>
source: 1_013_03 gTsang nag pa bstan pa byi dar bya.xml
